crafting.rationale: Crafting cost comes from gathered/extracted resources, time and failure risk. Quality rewards mastery rather than paying a higher currency fee.

allowed_uses: minimum merit/contribution history to access institution, mentor or recipe
permission gate for restricted materials or station access
forbidden_uses: subtract contribution when buying a consumable
subtract contribution when crafting a consumable

common_potion.role: reliable fallback that is weaker than crafted stable LI vitality medicine

crafted_vitality.rule: Básica/Templada/Profunda/Condensada are primarily crafted progression items. Institutional emergency stock may exist narratively but is not a permanent unlimited shop source.

pure_qi.rule: Pure Qi elixirs above introductory tier are primarily crafted.

special_medicines.rule: Antidotes, burn salves, meridian repair and hybrid medicines may be unlocked by institutional services, but access and price require a separate availability pass.

anti_arbitrage.guard: Do not create profitable vendor->craft->resale or ingredient->potion loops before a resale contract exists.

future_extensions.rule: Resolve after quality and base quantity; never alter potion quality.
